{"id":1848165249,"question_id":3886,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765008411,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1848165249/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Number of Trapezoids I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    const int mod = 1e9+7;\n    long long nCr(int n, int r) {\n    if (r > n) return 0;\n    if (r == 0 || r == n) return 1;\n\n    r = min(r, n - r);  \n\n    long long ans = 1;\n    for(int i = 1; i <= r; i++) \n    {\n        ans = ans * (n - r + i) / i;\n    }\n    return ans;\n}\n    int countTrapezoids(vector<vector<int>>& points) {\n        int trapezoids = 0;\n        int horizontals = 0;\n        int verticals = 0;\n\n        for(int i=0 ; i<points.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(points[i][1] == 0) horizontals++;\n            else verticals++;\n        }\n\n        int possible_hori_combo = (nCr(horizontals , 2)) % mod;\n        int possible_verti_combo = (nCr(verticals , 2)) % mod;\n\n        trapezoids = (possible_hori_combo * possible_verti_combo) % mod;\n    return trapezoids;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-number-of-trapezoids-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1230}
